chapter.heading: For the choir director: A song. A psalm, to be accompanied by stringed instruments.
chapter.v:
May God
be merciful and bless us.May his face smile with favor on us. Interlude

May your
ways be known throughout the earth,your saving power among people everywhere.

May the
nations praise you, O God.Yes, may all the nations praise you.

Let the
whole world sing for joy,because you govern the nations with justiceand guide the people of the whole world. Interlude

May the
nations praise you, O God.Yes, may all the nations praise you.

Then the
earth will yield its harvests,and God, our God, will richly bless us.

Yes, God
will bless us,and people all over the world will fear him.
